title: Cancel an order and recount
statementMd:
Delete all items of cancelled orders with a `DELETE`, then report how many order lines remain.

Expected columns: `lines`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')`.
solutionMd:
```sql
DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id IN (SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'); SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines FROM order_items;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
